title: Validate records asynchronously
summary: An import pipeline resolves rows asynchronously and validates them before accepting the batch. Collect valid and invalid row indexes so the caller can report every problem in one response. Validate asynchronously resolved import rows, reporting valid and invalid indexes.
requirements: A valid record has a nonempty string id and a nonnegative integer amount.
Each row is resolved asynchronously with Promise.resolve.
Return valid and invalid index arrays in input order.
hints: Map every row to an asynchronous validity check.
Await all checks, then separate the two groups using the original indexes.
